SD Tune - ComfyUI 的稳定扩散调谐工作流程

受 Midjourney Tune 启发的 Stable Diffusion 生态系统的 ComfyUI 工作流程。使用 SDXL Lightning 快速生成 16 张不同风格的图像。将您自己的通配符加载到动态提示引擎中以创建您自己的样式组合。 SDTune 引擎通过旨在控制帧生成的 AnimateDiff 节点，在一批中一个接一个地生成 16 个图像。

选择您喜欢的风格的一张或多张图像，然后将提示放入高质量生成工作流程中。准备好后，点击“进度图像”，图像（或图像组合）将被发送以根据您调整的风格以更高分辨率/质量生成。

一旦您拥有了喜欢的风格，就可以使用 Ultimate Upscaler 节点生成超高分辨率的放大图像。

安装注意事项：

确保将通配符加载到 ComfyUI 基本文件夹中的通配符目录中。

提示引擎可能对某些通配符集中的标点符号和符号很挑剔。

确保所有节点和舒适度都是最新的。

使用前请确保更新节点中使用的所有模型和路径。

需要安装用于数学、图像选择、动态提示、IP 适配器等的自定义节点。

v1b 注释 - 将 int 节点更改为原语以减少某些系统上的错误。添加了剪辑视觉准备节点。

v2 Notes - 切换到 SDXL Lightning 以获得更高质量的调谐图像、更快的生成和升级。添加了一些图像增强节点。实施了 IP 适配器 v2 节点。


感谢 -

运行扩散

Chris Goringe 提供了很棒的图像选择器节点！

用于 IP 适配器的 Matt3o。

无数其他节点创建者:)

大家测试过！

o.en:
SD Tune - Stable Diffusion Tune Workflow for ComfyUI

A ComfyUI workflow for the Stable Diffusion ecosystem inspired by Midjourney Tune. Quickly generate 16 images with SDXL Lightning in different styles. Load your own wildcards into the Dynamic Prompting engine to make your own styles combinations. The SDTune engine makes 16 images in one batch one after the other thanks to an AnimateDiff node meant to control frame generation.

Select one or multiple images in the style you like, and then put your prompt in the High Quality generation workflow. When you are ready, hit "Progress Images" and the image (or combination of images) will be sent to generate at a higher resolution / quality with your tuned style.

Once you have a style you like, generate ultra high resolution upscaled images with an Ultimate Upscaler node.

Installation notes:

Make sure to load in wildcards to a wildcards directory in your ComfyUI base folder.

The prompt engine can be finicky with punctuation and symbols in certain wildcard sets.

Make sure all nodes and comfy are up to date.

Make sure to update all models and paths used in nodes before use.

Custom nodes for math, image choice, dynamic prompting, ip adapter, etc will need to be installed.

v1b Notes - Changed int node to primitive to reduce errors on some systems. Added clip vision prep node.

v2 Notes - Switched to SDXL Lightning for higher quality tune images, faster generations and upscaling. Added some image enhancement nodes. Implemented IP Adapter v2 nodes.
